tracemalloc.note: Actual tracemalloc allocations made while tracing (brain, retained views, and indexes); corpus and store rows built before the window are not counted. Not an RSS reading.

count_only.estimate_note: retained_estimated_bytes is the engine's explicit object-size estimate, not RSS and not a hard process-memory cap; the byte budget uses the same estimate.
count_only.timing_note: No machine-time threshold is applied. elapsed_seconds is informational only and varies by machine.
